name: mixer-conversion-iip3
description: Conversion gain (power into 50 ohm, primary; voltage ratio, secondary), LO-to-RF leakage, and two-tone IIP3 for a single npn13G2 HBT active-mixer placeholder, via transient + coherent-bin FFT (low-side LO, 1 GHz IF per spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT LO-range row).
claim: PLACEHOLDER, NOT SPEC EVIDENCE: this bench proves the transient/FFT conversion-gain, LO-leakage, and two-tone-IIP3 extraction methodology works end to end against the real npn13G2 model, across the full HBT process x temperature x supply PVT grid. It does NOT claim any DRAFT target-spec row (spec/target-spec.md) is met -- the DUT is a single-ended, single-transistor mixer (RF and LO summed at one base node), not the double-balanced Gilbert-cell topology row 9's DRAFT target assumes, so LO-to-RF isolation in particular is expected to be far worse than a balanced design. SSB noise figure is NOT measured by this bench at all -- see evidence.notes for why (ngspice has no periodic-noise analysis; this is one of the three candidate routes spec/porting-plan.md S4.1 names, chosen here). IIP3 is a single-input-power extrapolation, NOT verified against a swept 1:3-slope region (spec/porting-plan.md S4.1 requires the latter for a real design's claim). Re-point this tb.json's netlist at design/'s ratified schematic once issue #1's spec is ratified and a real topology exists in design/.
netlist_provenance: schematic (placeholder harness-exercising stub; no ratified schematic exists in design/ yet -- design/README.md is still empty -- so this is neither the ratified schematic deck nor ever taken through layout, hence the parenthetical per testbench.py's PROVENANCE_RULE)

conversion_gain_db.description: Sensitivity floor only (NOT a spec-compliance check): proves the PVT grid genuinely perturbs the placeholder's conversion gain rather than silently simulating one corner for all requested points. Do not read this as 'meets the 8 dB DRAFT conversion-gain target' -- see the testbench claim above.

evidence.data_provenance: simulated (ngspice, real npn13G2 VBIC model, no PDK inductor model used anywhere in this fixture -- see notes)
notes: Two-tone plan: f1=19.4375 GHz, f2=19.4625 GHz (25 MHz spacing, centered on the Ka-band downlink DRAFT's 19.45 GHz), fLO=18.45 GHz (low-side, 1 GHz IF per spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT LO-range row). IF fundamentals at 987.5/1012.5 MHz, IM3 pair at 962.5/1037.5 MHz -- all exact integer multiples of 12.5 MHz by construction. Transient window: t=[20ns, 100ns] (80 ns, = 1/12.5MHz), tstep=10ps -- t<20ns is discarded as settle time so the FFT window is close to periodic steady state.

Coherent-bin caveat: ngspice's `fft` command zero-pads to the next power-of-two sample count, so the ACTUAL bin spacing is not exactly the intended 12.5 MHz (confirmed during development). This bench reads the actual bin spacing back at run time (frequency[1]-frequency[0]) and rounds each target frequency to its nearest bin dynamically, rather than hardcoding a bin index -- bounded by the standard rectangular-window scalloping loss (~3.9 dB worst case) when a target does not land exactly on a bin. Full derivation: this experiment's testbench/mixer_ce_placeholder.spice header comment.

conversion_gain_db is the PRIMARY figure per spec/target-spec.md row 9's port convention ('this document requires power conversion gain into a 50 ohm IF load as the primary'): Pfund_dBm - Pin_dBm, both already dBm-at-Z0=50 quantities so the conversion cancels. conv_gain_voltage_secondary_db (20*log10(vif1/0.01), a bare voltage ratio) is the explicitly-labelled SECONDARY the same row permits, kept only because it is what earlier drafts of this bench reported and is retained for continuity.

conversion_gain_db/pfund_dbm/pim3_dbm/iip3_dbm report the f1 IF fundamental (987.5 MHz) and the 2*f1-f2 IM3 product (962.5 MHz) pairing (the dominant/larger of the two IM3 sidebands observed during development -- the two sidebands are NOT symmetric for this single-ended, non-differential topology, unlike a balanced mixer; using the larger one is the more conservative (lower) IIP3 estimate).

IIP3 is extrapolated from a SINGLE input power point (vrf=10 mV, Pin=-36.02 dBm), not verified against a swept 1:3-slope region -- spec/porting-plan.md S4.1 explicitly requires the latter ('the sweep show the 1:3 slope region actually used for the extrapolation -- an IIP3 extrapolated from a compressed point is not an IIP3') for a real design's IIP3 claim. This bench's single-point number is sufficient to validate the extraction mechanics, not to claim a compression-verified IIP3.

dBm convention: Pin_dBm uses the standard available-power formula for a Thevenin source with series Z0 (V_peak^2/(8*Z0)); Pfund_dBm/Pim3_dBm/lo_rf_leak_dbm use V_peak^2/(2*Z0) at the (unterminated) output/RF-port node, i.e. Z0=50 ohm is a REPORTING reference only, not an assertion that the output is impedance-matched. Both dBc-difference terms (conversion_gain_db, the IIP3 extrapolation's Pfund-Pim3) are insensitive to this approximation since both sides use the identical conversion.

SSB noise figure: NOT SIMULATED. ngspice has no periodic-steady-state/periodic-noise (pnoise) analysis, so there is no valid way to linearize noise about this mixer's LO-pumped, time-varying operating point with a plain `.noise` analysis (which is only valid around a fixed DC bias point). spec/porting-plan.md S4.1 names three candidate routes for this (a transient-noise-source simulation; a manual per-LO-harmonic-sideband `.noise` sum; or an explicit 'not measurable in this flow' honest record) -- this bench takes the third. This is a real ngspice/general-SPICE tooling gap, not a klayout-tools gap -- klayout-tools does no simulation and is not invoked anywhere in this bench.

LO-to-RF leakage and the mismatch corners: spec/target-spec.md's verification-corners table calls for evaluating row 15 (LO leakage) against the HBT mismatch corner cards (hbt_typ_mismatch/hbt_bcs_mismatch/hbt_wcs_mismatch), since leakage is fundamentally a differential-pair symmetry effect in a balanced (Gilbert-cell) topology. This placeholder is SINGLE-ENDED -- there is no differential pair for a mismatch corner to unbalance -- so that guidance does not map onto this circuit; lo_rf_leak_dbm here is swept only against the plain (non-mismatch) hbt corner set. Revisit once a real, likely balanced, topology exists.

No PDK inductor model exists for SG13G2 (confirmed absent in IHP-Open-PDK -- see sg13g2-vco's known_model_gaps note, restated in sim/README.md, and independently re-confirmed in spec/porting-plan.md S4.2). This fixture avoids the gap entirely: no inductor of any kind appears anywhere in the circuit -- RF/LO ports are resistive-source, capacitively-coupled, and the collector load and base bias path are plain resistors.

PLACEHOLDER CIRCUIT: single-ended, single-transistor active mixer (RF and LO summed at one npn13G2 base, Nx=4), not the double-balanced Gilbert-cell topology row 9's DRAFT target assumes. No klayout-tools gap was hit producing this record -- this bench does no layout/DRC/LVS work; klt is out of scope for a pre-layout mixer bench.
